# SURFACE WATER SUPPLY, 1927, PART XL

SAN DIEGUITO RIVER AT LANE HODGES, GALIF.

LOCATION.-I NW. 1/4,sec. 18, T. 13 S., R. 2 W., at Lake Hodges Dam, 51/2 miles southwest of Escondido. DRAINAGE AREA.-299 square miles. RECORDS AVAILABLE-January, 1916, to September, 1927. REMARKS.-Diversions for irrigation in San Pasqual Valley above Lake Hodges; also pumping from wells along river. Lake Hodges Dam completed in 1919 and gaging station formerly maintained at dam site was abandoned, Follow- ing table, furnished by city of San Diego, gives monthly storage in reservoir and other data from which inflow is computed.

Inflow of San Dieguito River to Lake Hodges, Calif., 1925-26 and 1926-27
